Resource bars: LUT, FF, BRAM and DSP used on the XC7A200T

A real nextpnr-xilinx run counted against the XC7A200T's own totals, read from the chipdb and prjxray-db. Drop your routed JSON and it counts yours.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/trinity-fpga de4ebda367: fpga/openxc7-synth/trinity_v3_jtaguart.v and jtaguart.xdc
  • nextpnr-xilinx 0.9.2-107-g7037c948 --chipdb xc7a200tfbg676-1.bin --report report.json: used and available BEL counts
  • prjxray-db 517d66a383 artix7: xc7a200t/tilegrid.json site counts, xc7a200tfbg676-1 and xc7a200tfbg484-1 package_pins.csv
  • AMD DS180 7 Series FPGAs Product Selection Guide: XC7A200T totals, cross-checked
